title: Boston Gas Company filed for approval the Second Amendment to the 365-Day Gas Purchase agreement and Wellesley College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Company's Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners l Besser, Connelly, Keating, Vasington and Sullivan.
Letter of Boston Gas Company withdrawing their request not to disclose the Customer's identity. By Jeffery M. Leupold. GC99-23
